reply.text:
You’re not undoing your recovery. Three nights of pizza is not a disaster. It’s just three meals.

Bones heal from the overall pattern, not from one imperfect week. So don’t spiral, and don’t try to “make up for it” by under-eating tomorrow.

### What to do now

| When | Focus | Simple target |
|---|---|---|
| Next meal | Re-center | Protein + calcium-rich food + fruit/veg |
| Today | Hydrate | Water through the day; don’t skip meals |
| Next 2–3 days | Support bone healing | 3 solid meals/day, each with protein |
| This week | Restore balance | Include dairy or fortified alternatives, leafy greens, eggs, fish, tofu, beans |

### Easy reset meals
- Greek yogurt + fruit + oats
- Eggs + toast + spinach
- Chicken/tofu rice bowl with veg
- Salmon/tinned sardines + potatoes + salad
- Cottage cheese or milk + banana

### The main thing
- Get back to normal eating.
- Prioritize protein at each meal.
- Keep calcium and vitamin D in the picture.
- Keep recovery steady. No guilt tax.

If you want, I can give you a 1-day bone-healing reset menu in metric units that’s easy to follow tomorrow.
